candidate_workaround: Guard every projected JSON value by its actual type and create an additive x2 index supplement instead of rewriting the frozen x1 inventory.
failure_signature: A compact index probe assumed every dictionary-shaped branch had dictionary values and called keys on a scalar string.
recurrence_guard: Before projecting heterogeneous JSON, branch explicitly for mapping, list, scalar, and null values; never mutate a frozen index to recover an inspection fault.
rollback: Stop the projection, retain the type-assumption fault, leave the x1 index unchanged, and use a type-guarded read plus additive x2 supplement.
scope_boundary: Bounded owner-local schema inspection and additive indexing only; no production, authority, scientific, or independent-reproduction credit.
title: Type-guard heterogeneous JSON index projection
trigger_preconditions: index contains mappings, lists, and scalar metadata
frozen x1 index must remain unchanged
